ModMetaData.name: D'thorga Missile Patches
ModMetaData.author: Phobos A. D'thorga
ModMetaData.description:
Fixes for InterRim Ballistic Missile, switched on only while it is active. It copies nothing from it.
A strategic warhead no longer hangs the game when it lands. The missile mod destroys everything on the struck map in a single frame, and on a large, heavily modded map that frame can run for minutes until Windows closes the game as not responding. With this, the blast crosses the map a slice per frame, from the centre outward, within a time budget you can set, and the game stays responsive. Everything the warhead would have destroyed is still destroyed; only the pacing changes. A blast that takes more than a moment says so in a message, and says when it is done.
Needs D'thorga Framework. Load it after InterRim Ballistic Missile; it does nothing without it.
